$comment: The WebAuthn origin Credential Manager writes for an Android app: android:apk-key-hash: + base64url WITHOUT padding of the SHA-256 of the signing certificate's DER. Read by RestoreOriginTest.kt (the app's own read, ApkKeyHash.origin over derHex) and restore-config.spec.ts (the server's apkKeyHashOrigin over fingerprint): the two must produce the same origin, or the client's skip decision and the server's verdict disagree (docs/wiki/account-restore.md).

cases.name: a certificate whose digest needs both URL-safe characters
